answer_text:
The oldest brother in *7th Heaven* was **Matt Camden**, played by **Barry Watson**. Barry Watson played the moody, rebellious, and flirty eldest Camden kid, Matt, on *7th Heaven*, from 1996 to 2007.

Watson's Matt Camden was seen as an emblem of a great big brother, constantly trying his best to be a role model for the rest of the Camden kids. Matt was also very likable, outgoing, and easy to talk to, making him a clear fan-favorite character.

Watson was diagnosed with Hodgkin's lymphoma in 2002, forcing him to step away from his acting career to focus on his health and recovery. He was able to return for the 150th episode of *7th Heaven* and continued as a guest until the series concluded.
